ModMetaData.name: Quick Build
ModMetaData.author: Nahuel
ModMetaData.description:
Builds faster without cheating materials.
Multiplies the construction speed stat (build, deconstruct, repair, roofs, floors) by a slider in the mod settings, x1 to x20 (default x10). Materials are still needed and hauled; only the work goes faster. By default only your colony benefits.
